summary: 名词性从句就是「一句话当名词用」，可以在句子里当主语、宾语、表语或同位语。它由连接词引导，从句一律用陈述语序。
points: 按在句中的位置分四种：主语从句（What he said is true.）、宾语从句（I know he is right.）、表语从句（The problem is that we have no time.）、同位语从句（The news that he won is true.）。
连接词分三类：that（不作成分、无词义）；whether/if（是否）；连接代词 what/who/whom/whose/which 和连接副词 when/where/why/how（在从句中作成分）。
从句一律用陈述语序：I don't know where he lives.（不能写成 where does he live）
名词性从句在句中的功能相当于名词，能作主语、宾语、表语、同位语；定语从句只能修饰它前面的名词。
连接词不作成分的只有 that/whether/if，其余都要在从句里担任主语、宾语、定语或状语——这是选词的第一个依据。

examples.en: What he said is true.
examples.note: what 引导主语从句，同时在从句中作 said 的宾语。

examples.en: I don't know where he lives.
examples.note: 宾语从句用陈述语序 lives，不是 does he live。

examples.en: The problem is that we have no time.
examples.note: that 引导表语从句，不作任何成分，也没有词义。

examples.en: The news that he won the game is true.
examples.zh: 他赢了比赛的消息是真的。
examples.note: that 从句作 news 的同位语，说明消息的具体内容。

title: that 从句的用法
summary: that 在名词性从句里只起连接作用，不作成分也没有词义。它在宾语从句里常可省略，在主语、表语和同位语从句里一般不省。
points: that 不作成分、不翻译，只把从句「挂」到主句上：I think (that) he is right.
宾语从句里的 that 常省略；主语从句、表语从句、同位语从句里的 that 一般不省略：The fact is that he lied.
主语从句用 that 时，习惯用 it 作形式主语，把从句后移：It is clear that he is lying.
同位语从句的 that 既不能省略，也不能换成 which：the idea that we should leave early。
区分定语从句：that 引导定语从句时必须在从句中作主语或宾语，引导名词性从句时不作成分。

examples.en: I think (that) he is right.
examples.note: 宾语从句的 that 可以省略。

examples.en: The fact is that nobody told him.
examples.note: 表语从句的 that 一般不省略。

examples.en: It is clear that he is lying.
examples.note: 主语从句后移，it 作形式主语。

examples.en: The idea that we should leave early is good.
examples.zh: 我们早点走的想法不错。
examples.note: 同位语从句的 that 不能省，也不能换成 which。

title: whether 与 if
summary: whether 和 if 都表示「是否」，但 if 只能引导宾语从句，whether 可以引导全部四种名词性从句。介词后面、句首、不定式前面都只能用 whether。
points: 引导宾语从句时两者都能用：I wonder whether/if he will come.
只能用 whether 的四种情况：介词后面（It depends on whether...）、句首（Whether he comes is unknown.）、与 or not 直接连用、后接不定式（whether to go）。
if 还能引导条件状语从句，whether 不能：If it rains, we'll stay in.（条件状语从句）
whether 引导主语从句时可用 it 作形式主语：It doesn't matter whether he agrees.

examples.en: I wonder whether he will come.
examples.note: 宾语从句里 whether 可以换成 if。

examples.en: It depends on whether we have enough money.
examples.zh: 这取决于我们的钱够不够。
examples.note: 介词 on 后面只能用 whether。

examples.en: Whether he comes or not doesn't matter.
examples.note: 句首的主语从句只能用 whether。

examples.en: I don't know whether to accept the offer.
examples.zh: 我不知道是否接受这个职位。
examples.note: whether 后可以直接跟不定式，if 不行。

examples.en: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
examples.note: 这里是条件状语从句，不是名词性从句，不能用 whether。

title: 连接代词
en: Wh- Pronouns: what · who · whom · whose · which
summary: 连接代词既连接从句，又在从句里充当主语、宾语或定语。what 最特殊：它自带「先行词」，等于 the thing(s) that。
points: what = the thing(s) that，在从句中作主语或宾语：What he needs is a rest.
who 指人作主语；whom 指人作宾语（口语常用 who）；whose 作定语，后面直接跟名词。
which 表示「哪几个」，有范围限制；what 没有范围。
whatever / whoever / whichever 表示「无论什么/谁/哪个」，引导让步或泛指的名词性从句。
连接代词本身有词义，从句里不能再出现它所代替的词：What he said it is wrong → 去掉 it。

examples.en: What he needs is a rest.
examples.note: what 在从句中作 needs 的宾语，整个从句作主语。

examples.en: Who will be the next captain is still unknown.
examples.zh: 谁会成为下一任队长还不清楚。
examples.note: who 指人，在从句中作主语。

examples.en: I don't know which of the two he prefers.
examples.zh: 我不知道这两个他更喜欢哪个。
examples.note: which 有范围限制，这里是「两个中选一个」。

examples.en: Whoever breaks the rule will be punished.
examples.note: whoever 相当于 anyone who，在从句中作主语。

title: 连接副词
en: Wh- Adverbs: when · where · why · how
summary: 连接副词在从句中作状语，分别表示时间、地点、原因、方式或程度。判断用代词还是副词，只看从句缺状语还是缺主语、宾语。
points: when、where、why、how 在从句中分别作时间、地点、原因、方式状语：I don't know when he left.
how 还能与形容词、副词连用表示程度：how fast、how long、how many。
从句一律陈述语序：Do you know where he lives? 不是 where does he live。
连接副词引导的从句可以作主语、宾语、表语：Where he went remains a mystery.

examples.en: I don't know when he left.
examples.zh: 我不知道他什么时候走的。
examples.note: when 在从句中作时间状语，从句用陈述语序。

examples.en: Do you know where he lives?
examples.note: 从句是 where he lives，不能倒装成 where does he live。

examples.en: Tell me why you were late.
examples.note: why 作原因状语。

examples.en: How he finished it in two days is amazing.
examples.zh: 他两天就完成了，真让人惊讶。
examples.note: how 引导主语从句，在从句中作方式状语。

title: 主语从句与形式主语
summary: 主语从句放在句首会让句子头重脚轻，英语习惯用 it 占住主语位置，把从句移到后面。it 只是形式主语，不译成「它」。
points: it 作形式主语的常见句型：It is said/reported/believed that...；It seems/appears that...；It doesn't matter whether...
形容词作表语时也常用 it：It is obvious that...；It is important that...（从句常用 should do，should 可省略）。
主语从句作主语时，谓语一般用单数：What he said is true. / Whether they agree doesn't matter.
句首不能用 if 引导主语从句，要用 whether；that 引导时一般不省略。
what 引导的主语从句不能换成 that：What matters is your attitude.（不是 That matters）

examples.en: It is said that he has moved abroad.
examples.zh: 据说他已经搬到国外了。
examples.note: it 是形式主语，that 从句才是真正的主语。

examples.en: It is important that everyone (should) be on time.
examples.note: 这类形容词后的从句常用 should do，should 可以省略。

examples.en: What he said is true.
examples.note: what 从句作主语，谓语用单数 is。

examples.en: Whether we go or not doesn't matter.
examples.note: 主语从句用 whether，不能用 if。

title: 宾语从句与时态呼应
summary: 宾语从句最常考两件事：主句是过去时的时候，从句要不要跟着后移时态；以及 think、believe 这类词的否定转移。
points: 时态呼应：主句是过去时，从句一般要用过去的某个时态：He said he was busy.
例外：从句表示客观真理、自然规律时，仍用一般现在时：The teacher said the earth moves around the sun.
否定转移：think、believe、suppose、expect 后接 that 从句时，否定要提到主句：I don't think he is right.
宾语从句的 that 常省略；whether/if 和连接代词、连接副词都不能省。
有些动词后接「疑问词 + 不定式」更简洁：I don't know what to do.

examples.en: He said he was busy.
examples.note: 主句是过去时，从句用过去时 was。

examples.en: The teacher said the earth moves around the sun.
examples.zh: 老师说地球绕着太阳转。
examples.note: 客观真理不受时态呼应影响，仍用一般现在时。

examples.en: I don't think he is right.
examples.note: 否定转移到主句，是英语的习惯表达。

examples.en: I don't know what to do.
examples.note: what to do 是宾语从句的简化形式。

title: 表语从句
summary: 表语从句跟在系动词后面，说明主语是什么或怎么样。最常出现在 The reason is that...、That's why...、It seems that... 这几类句子里。
points: 常见系动词后接表语从句：be、seem、look、appear、remain：The trouble is that we are late.
The reason is that... 用 that 不用 because，否则意思重复。
That's why...（结果）与 That's because...（原因）要分清。
表语从句用陈述语序；whether 可以引导，if 一般不行。
as if / as though 也能引导表语从句：It looks as if it will rain.

examples.en: The trouble is that we are late.
examples.note: that 引导表语从句，不作成分。

examples.en: The reason is that he didn't prepare.
examples.note: 不用 because，否则和前面的 reason 重复。

examples.en: That's why he was late.
examples.note: why 从句表示结果。

examples.en: That's because he missed the bus.
examples.zh: 那是因为他错过了公交车。
examples.note: because 从句表示原因，注意与 why 的区别。

examples.en: It looks as if it will rain.
examples.note: as if 引导表语从句。

title: 同位语从句
summary: 同位语从句跟在抽象名词后面，说明这个名词的具体内容。它和定语从句最大的区别：that 在从句里不作成分。
points: 常见先行名词：news、fact、idea、hope、belief、doubt、promise、possibility、evidence。
同位语从句的 that 不作成分、不能省略；定语从句的 that 要作主语或宾语。
判断方法：把 that 去掉，从句结构仍完整的是同位语从句；缺主语或宾语的是定语从句。
同位语从句还可以用 whether、how、when 等引导：the question whether we should go。

examples.en: The news that our team won is exciting.
examples.zh: 我们队获胜的消息令人兴奋。
examples.note: that 从句结构完整、不作成分，是同位语从句。

examples.en: The news that he told us is exciting.
examples.zh: 他告诉我们的那个消息令人兴奋。
examples.note: tell 缺宾语，that 在从句中作宾语，是定语从句。

examples.en: I have no idea when he will come back.
examples.zh: 我不知道他什么时候回来。
examples.note: when 引导同位语从句，说明 idea 的内容。

examples.en: There is a possibility that he will resign.
examples.note: that 从句说明 possibility 的具体内容。

title: 与定语从句辨析
summary: 名词性从句和定语从句都用 that、what、when 这些词，区别只有一条：引导词在从句里作不作成分、从句前面有没有名词。抓住这条，大半的题都能判断。
points: 定语从句前面一定有先行词；名词性从句前面没有（同位语从句除外，它前面的名词是被说明内容的对象）。
that 在定语从句中作主语或宾语，在名词性从句中不作成分：删掉 that 后从句仍完整的是名词性从句。
what 只能引导名词性从句，因为它自带先行词，定语从句不需要它。
名词性从句一律陈述语序，这是最高频的错误：I don't know where he is.（不是 where is he）
时态呼应、否定转移、whether/if 的选择，是宾语从句的三个固定考点。

examples.en: I know that he is a teacher.
examples.note: 名词性从句：that 不作成分，删掉后 he is a teacher 仍然完整。

examples.en: The man that is standing there is my uncle.
examples.zh: 站在那儿的那个男人是我叔叔。
examples.note: 定语从句：that 作从句主语，不能删。

examples.en: What he bought surprised us.
examples.zh: 他买的东西让我们很惊讶。
examples.note: what 引导主语从句，自带「先行词」，不能用 that。

examples.en: I don't know where he is.
examples.note: 名词性从句用陈述语序，不能写成 where is he。

title: 虚拟语气入门
summary: 虚拟语气不陈述事实，而是表达假设、愿望、建议或与事实相反的情况。它的核心是「时态后移」：用过去的时态表示不真实，用 would/could/might + 动词表示结果。
points: 英语有三种语气：陈述（He is ill.）、祈使（Go home.）、虚拟（If he were here, we would ask him.）。
虚拟的核心是时态后移：与现在相反用一般过去时，与过去相反用过去完成时，与将来相反用 were to do 或 should do。
主句谓语通常是 would/could/might/should + 动词原形，不用 will/can。
判断时间只看「假设的内容」发生在什么时候，不看整句；主从时间不一致就分开处理（混合虚拟）。
虚拟语气的时态不表示时间先后，而表示「与事实的距离」——越远的时态表示越不真实。

examples.en: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会接受这个职位。
examples.note: 与现在事实相反：从句用 were，主句用 would + 动词原形。

examples.en: If he had studied harder, he would have passed.
examples.zh: 如果他当时更努力，就通过了。
examples.note: 与过去事实相反：had done + would have done。

examples.en: I wish I could fly.
examples.note: wish 后与现在事实相反，用过去时 could。

examples.en: It is important that everyone (should) be on time.
examples.note: 建议类从句用 should do，should 可以省略。

title: 与现在事实相反
summary: 与现在事实相反：从句用一般过去时（be 一律用 were），主句用 would/could/might/should + 动词原形。记住公式就能直接套。
points: 公式：If + 主语 + 动词过去式（be 用 were）, 主语 + would/could/might/should + 动词原形。
be 动词在虚拟条件句里通常用 were；口语里第一、三人称也可能用 was，写作中建议用 were。
主句的助动词有分工：would 表结果，could 表能力或可能性，might 表较小的可能，should 表「应该、竟然」。
从句虽用一般过去时，但不表示过去时间，而是表示「现在不真实」。
常见搭配：If I were you、If it were not for（要不是）、If only（要是……就好了）。

examples.en: If I were you, I would tell him the truth.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会告诉他真相。
examples.note: 与现在相反：were + would do。

examples.en: If it were not for your help, I would fail.
examples.zh: 要不是你的帮助，我会失败。
examples.note: were not for 是固定搭配，表示与现在事实相反。

examples.en: If he knew the answer, he would tell us.
examples.zh: 如果他知道答案，他会告诉我们的。
examples.note: 从句 knew 表示他现在并不知道。

examples.en: If I had more time, I could travel around the world.
examples.zh: 如果我有更多时间，我就能环游世界。
examples.note: could 表示能力，had 表过去但指的是现在。

title: 与过去事实相反
summary: 与过去事实相反：从句用过去完成时 had done，主句用 would/could/might + have done。这是各类考试里出现最多的一种虚拟。
points: 公式：If + 主语 + had done, 主语 + would/could/might + have done。
从句 had done 表示「当时其实没做」，主句 would have done 表示「当时就会……」。
最常见的错误是主句漏掉 have：写成 would pass 就变成「与现在相反」了。
否定形式：If he hadn't been ill, he would have come. / If it hadn't been for（要不是当时）。
条件从句里的 had done 是虚拟，不是「过去的过去」，不要按时间先后去理解。

examples.en: If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
examples.zh: 如果我当时知道真相，我会告诉你的。
examples.note: 与过去相反：had known + would have told。

examples.en: If she had left earlier, she wouldn't have missed the train.
examples.zh: 如果她早点出发，就不会错过火车。
examples.note: 主句用 wouldn't have done，与从句的 had done 配套。

examples.en: If it hadn't been for the rain, we would have arrived on time.
examples.zh: 要不是下雨，我们就准时到了。
examples.note: hadn't been for 表示与过去事实相反。

examples.en: He would have passed the exam if he had prepared better.
examples.zh: 如果他准备得更好，本可以通过考试。
examples.note: 从句后置也可以，意思完全不变。

title: 与将来事实相反
summary: 对将来可能性很小的假设：从句用 were to do / should do / 一般过去时，主句用 would/could/might + 动词原形。三种从句形式语气依次减弱。
points: 公式：If + 主语 + were to do / should do / did, 主语 + would/could/might + do。
were to do 表示「万一、假如真的」，可能性最小、最正式；should do 次之；一般过去时最口语。
主句仍用 would do，不用 would have done（除非整句指向过去）。
和真实条件句区分：真实条件用一般现在时（If it rains, we'll stay in.），虚拟用上面三种形式。
常见表达：If you should change your mind, let me know.

examples.en: If it were to rain tomorrow, the match would be cancelled.
examples.zh: 万一明天下雨，比赛就取消。
examples.note: were to do 表示对将来的假设，可能性很小。

examples.en: If he should come, please tell him to wait.
examples.zh: 万一他来了，请让他等一会儿。
examples.note: should come 的语气比 were to 略轻，主句可以是祈使句。

examples.en: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
examples.zh: 如果我中了彩票，我就买套房子。
examples.note: 一般过去时表示对将来的低概率假设，最口语。

examples.en: If you should change your mind, let me know.
examples.zh: 万一你改变主意，告诉我一声。
examples.note: 主句是祈使句，从句仍用 should do。

title: 混合虚拟与倒装
summary: 主句和从句时间不一致时，各自用各自的形式，这叫混合虚拟；把 if 省掉时从句要倒装，把 were/had/should 提到主语前面。
points: 混合虚拟：从句指过去、主句指现在（或反过来），分别套各自的公式：If I had taken your advice, I would be a doctor now.
省略 if 的倒装：Were I you...（= If I were you）、Had I known...（= If I had known）、Should it rain...（= If it should rain）。
倒装只发生在这三个词上（were / had / should），其他动词不能提前。
写成倒装后就没有 if，主从句之间仍要用逗号隔开。
混合虚拟最常见的情况是「过去的因导致现在的果」。

examples.en: If I had taken your advice, I would be a doctor now.
examples.zh: 如果我当时听了你的建议，现在就是医生了。
examples.note: 从句指过去（had taken），主句指现在（would be）。

examples.en: Were I you, I would apologize at once.
examples.note: 省略 if 后 were 提到主语前面。

examples.en: Had I known earlier, I would have helped.
examples.zh: 我要是早点知道，就会帮忙了。
examples.note: had 提前，等于 If I had known。

examples.en: Should it rain tomorrow, we would stay at home.
examples.zh: 万一明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
examples.note: should 提前，表示对将来的假设。

title: wish 的用法
summary: wish 后面的从句用虚拟语气，表示愿望与现实相反：现在用过去时，过去用过去完成时，将来用 would/could do。if only 用法相同，语气更强。
points: wish + 过去时：与现在事实相反（I wish I knew the answer.）。
wish + 过去完成时：与过去事实相反（I wish I had studied harder.）。
wish + would/could do：对将来的愿望，或希望别人改变做法（I wish it would stop raining.）。
if only 表示「要是……就好了」，三种时间的用法与 wish 相同，语气更强烈。
wish 后不用 will，也不用一般现在时；hope 才表示「希望（有可能实现）」，用陈述语气。

examples.en: I wish I knew the answer.
examples.note: 与现在相反：wish + 过去时 knew。

examples.en: I wish I had studied harder at school.
examples.zh: 我真希望上学时更用功。
examples.note: 与过去相反：wish + 过去完成时。

examples.en: I wish it would stop raining.
examples.note: 对将来的愿望：wish + would do。

examples.en: If only I had listened to you!
examples.zh: 要是我当时听你的就好了！
examples.note: if only 与 wish 同形，语气更强。

examples.en: I hope you will come tomorrow.
examples.note: hope 表示可能实现的希望，用陈述语气，不用虚拟。

title: as if 从句
summary: as if / as though 表示「好像、仿佛」。与事实不符时后面的从句用虚拟：与现在相反用过去时，与过去相反用过去完成时；事实可能成立时用陈述语气。
points: as if / as though + 过去时：与现在事实相反（He talks as if he knew everything.）。
as if / as though + 过去完成时：与过去事实相反（He looked as if he had seen a ghost.）。
事实可能成立时用陈述语气：It looks as if it is going to rain.
从句主语与主句相同时，可以简化成 as if doing 或 as if to do：He nodded as if to say yes.
口语里 like 可以代替 as if，正式写作仍用 as if / as though。

examples.en: He talks as if he knew everything.
examples.zh: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
examples.note: 与现在相反，用过去时 knew。

examples.en: He looked as if he had seen a ghost.
examples.note: 与过去相反，用过去完成时。

examples.en: It looks as if it is going to rain.
examples.note: 事实可能成立，用陈述语气 is going to。

examples.en: He nodded as if to say yes.
examples.zh: 他点了点头，好像在说「是」。
examples.note: 主语一致时可简化成 as if to do。

title: 建议与要求类
summary: suggest、insist、demand、order、require 等动词后的宾语从句，以及 It is necessary/important that...，用（should）+ 动词原形，should 可以省略。
points: 记忆口诀：一坚持（insist）、二命令（order、command）、三建议（suggest、advise、propose、recommend）、四要求（demand、require、request、ask）后接 (should) do。
这些动词变被动或名词形式后，从句同样用 should do：It is suggested that... / the suggestion that...
It is necessary / important / essential / natural / strange that + (should) do。
should 常省略，所以从句里出现动词原形（be、go）不算语法错误；但动词不能变时态或单复数。
insist 表示「坚持说」时用陈述语气：He insisted that he was innocent.

examples.en: I suggest that he (should) see a doctor.
examples.note: suggest 后的从句用 should do，should 可省。

examples.en: It is necessary that everyone (should) be present.
examples.note: It is necessary that 后用 should do，be 用原形。

examples.en: The manager demanded that the report (should) be finished today.
examples.zh: 经理要求报告今天完成。
examples.note: demand 后的从句用 be done，should 省略。

examples.en: He insisted that he was innocent.
examples.zh: 他坚持说自己是无辜的。
examples.note: insist 表示「坚持说」时用陈述语气 was。

examples.en: It was suggested that the meeting (should) be put off.
examples.note: 被动结构后的从句同样用 should do。

title: 固定句型
en: would rather · It's time · but for
summary: 虚拟语气还藏在几个固定句型里：It is (high) time that...、would rather + 从句、but for / otherwise、lest / for fear that。这些句型记公式最快。
points: It is (high/about) time that + 过去时（也可用 should do）：It is time we went home.
would rather + 从句：现在或将来用过去时（I'd rather you came tomorrow.），过去用过去完成时（I'd rather you hadn't told him.）；would rather do sth 直接跟原形，不用虚拟。
but for = 要不是，主句用虚拟：But for your help, I would have failed.
otherwise / or 表示「否则」，后面的分句用虚拟：I was busy, otherwise I would have come.
lest / for fear that 引导的从句常用 should do：He ran fast lest he (should) miss the bus.

examples.en: It is high time we went home.
examples.note: It is high time that 后用过去时 went。

examples.en: I'd rather you came tomorrow.
examples.note: would rather + 从句，指将来用过去时 came。

examples.en: But for your help, I would have failed.
examples.zh: 要不是你的帮助，我就失败了。
examples.note: but for 相当于 if it had not been for。

examples.en: I was busy, otherwise I would have come.
examples.zh: 我当时很忙，否则就来了。
examples.note: otherwise 后的分句用虚拟 would have done。

examples.en: He ran fast lest he should miss the bus.
examples.zh: 他跑得很快，生怕错过公交车。
examples.note: lest 后常用 should do，should 也可省略。

title: 易错点与辨析
summary: 虚拟语气的错集中在三处：该用虚拟却用了陈述（漏掉 were / had）、主句时态没跟上从句、以及把「坚持说」当成「坚持要求」。先分清真实条件和不真实条件。
points: 真实条件用陈述语气（If it rains, we'll stay in.），与事实相反才用虚拟，两类不能混用。
与现在相反 be 用 were；与过去相反从句必须 had done、主句必须 would have done，两边要配套。
建议类从句里 should 可以省略，但动词必须是原形：He suggested that she go（不是 goes / went）。
insist 表示「坚持说」用陈述语气，表示「坚持要求」才用 should do。
wish 后不能用 will 或一般现在时；hope 后用陈述语气。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
examples.note: 真实条件句用陈述语气，不用虚拟形式。

examples.en: If I were you, I would apologize.
examples.note: 与现在相反：were + would do，be 不用 was。

examples.en: If he had left earlier, he would have caught the bus.
examples.zh: 如果他早点出发，就赶上公交车了。
examples.note: had done + would have done，两边要配套，缺一个就错。

examples.en: She suggested that he (should) take a rest.
examples.note: 从句动词用原形 take，不能写成 takes 或 took。

examples.en: I hope he comes tomorrow.
examples.note: hope 用陈述语气；换成 wish 才需要虚拟。

title: 倒装入门
summary: 英语的基本语序是「主语 + 谓语」，把谓语或助动词放到主语前面就是倒装。倒装分两种：整个谓语提前叫完全倒装，只提前助动词或情态动词叫部分倒装。
points: 正常语序是主语在前、谓语在后；倒装则把谓语动词或助动词移到主语前面。
完全倒装：谓语动词整个提前，多见于 here/there 开头、方位状语提前、表语提前（Here comes the bus.）。
部分倒装：只把助动词、情态动词或 be 动词提前，实义动词仍留在主语后面（Never have I seen such a film.）。
倒装的三个动机：强调（否定词、only 开头）、平衡句子（主语太长）、固定句型（so do I、as/though 让步）。
判断方法：看句首是不是否定词、only + 状语、so/neither、方位状语，或虚拟条件句省略了 if——只要沾上其中一条就考虑倒装。

examples.en: Here comes the bus.
examples.note: 完全倒装：谓语 comes 整个提前，主语 the bus 在后。

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
examples.zh: 我从没见过这么美的地方。
examples.note: 部分倒装：助动词 have 提前，seen 留在主语后面。

examples.en: Only then did I realize my mistake.
examples.zh: 直到那时我才意识到自己的错误。
examples.note: only + 状语放句首，助动词 did 提前。

examples.en: She likes music, and so do I.
examples.note: so + 助动词 + 主语，表示「也一样」。

title: 完全倒装
summary: 完全倒装把整个谓语动词放到主语前面，常见于 here/there/now/then 开头、方位介词短语提前和表语提前。谓语多为不及物动词，主语多为名词。
points: here、there、now、then 开头，谓语用 come、go、be 等不及物动词：Here comes the bus. / There goes the bell.
方位、地点状语提前：On the wall hangs a picture. / In the corner sat an old man.
表语提前：Happy are those who help others. / Such was his answer.
主语是代词时不倒装：Here it is.（不是 Here is it.）/ Away he went.
谓语一般是不及物动词（come、go、stand、lie、sit、hang、be），且多用一般现在时或一般过去时。

examples.en: Here comes the bus.
examples.note: here + 不及物动词，谓语整个提前。

examples.en: On the wall hangs a map of China.
examples.zh: 墙上挂着一张中国地图。
examples.note: 方位状语提前，谓语 hangs 提到主语前。

examples.en: In the corner sat an old man.
examples.note: 地点状语提前，sat 提到主语前。

examples.en: Here it is.
examples.note: 主语是代词 it，不能倒装成 Here is it。

examples.en: Such was his answer.
examples.note: 表语 such 提前，be 动词提到主语前面。

title: 否定词开头
summary: never、seldom、hardly、not until、no sooner...than 等否定或半否定词放句首时要部分倒装：把助动词提到主语前，实义动词留在后面。
points: 常见开头词：never、seldom、rarely、hardly、scarcely、little、nowhere、not only、not until、no sooner。
结构：否定词 + 助动词/情态动词/be + 主语 + 实义动词。
no sooner...than、hardly/scarcely...when 表示「一……就」，前半句倒装且用过去完成时。
not only...but also 连接两个分句时，只有 not only 所在的分句倒装。
not until 提到句首时，主句倒装，until 引导的部分用正常语序。

examples.en: Never have I heard such a story.
examples.zh: 我从没听过这样的故事。
examples.note: never 开头，助动词 have 提前。

examples.en: Seldom does he go to the cinema.
examples.note: seldom 开头，借助动词 does，实义动词用原形。

examples.en: No sooner had he arrived than it began to rain.
examples.note: no sooner 开头用过去完成时倒装，than 后面的分句不倒装。

examples.en: Not only did she sing, but she also danced.
examples.note: not only 所在分句倒装，but also 分句用正常语序。

examples.en: Not until midnight did he come back.
examples.note: not until 提前，主句倒装。

title: only 开头
summary: only 修饰的状语或状语从句放到句首时，主句要部分倒装。关键是 only 修饰的必须是状语，修饰主语时不倒装。
points: 结构：Only + 状语（短语或从句）+ 助动词 + 主语 + 实义动词。
常见形式：only then、only later、only in this way、only by doing、only when、only if、only after。
only 修饰主语时不倒装：Only he knows the answer.
only + 从句放句首时，从句本身用正常语序，倒装的是主句。
与强调句 It is only... that... 区分：那是强调句，不改变语序。

examples.en: Only then did I understand what he meant.
examples.zh: 直到那时我才明白他的意思。
examples.note: only + then，主句助动词 did 提前。

examples.en: Only in this way can we solve the problem.
examples.zh: 只有这样我们才能解决问题。
examples.note: only + 介词短语，情态动词 can 提前。

examples.en: Only when he left did I know the truth.
examples.zh: 直到他离开我才知道真相。
examples.note: 从句 when he left 用正常语序，主句倒装。

examples.en: Only he knows the answer.
examples.note: only 修饰主语 he，句子不倒装。

examples.en: It was only then that I understood.
examples.note: 这是强调句 It was...that...，不是倒装。

title: so 与 neither
summary: so 表示「……也是」，neither/nor 表示「……也不」，结构是「so/neither + 助动词 + 主语」，助动词要和前一句保持一致。
points: 肯定附和：so + 助动词 + 主语（She can swim. — So can I.）。
否定附和：neither/nor + 助动词 + 主语（I don't like it. — Neither do I.）。
助动词必须与前一句一致：be 用 be，完成时用 have，一般现在时用 do/does。
前一句谓语类型不同时，可用 So it is with sb / It is the same with sb 统一处理。
注意区分「so + 主语 + 助动词」表示「确实如此」的正常语序：— She is tired. — So she is.

examples.en: She can swim, and so can I.
examples.note: so + can + 主语，助动词与前句一致。

examples.en: I don't like coffee. — Neither do I.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢咖啡。——我也不喜欢。
examples.note: 否定附和用 neither + do + 主语。

examples.en: He has finished, and so have they.
examples.zh: 他完成了，他们也完成了。
examples.note: 前句用 have，附和句也用 have。

examples.en: — It's raining. — So it is.
examples.note: so + 主语 + 助动词表示「确实如此」，是正常语序，不是倒装。

title: 虚拟条件倒装
summary: 虚拟条件句省略 if 时，把 were、had、should 提到主语前面。这三种倒装是考试里最常考的倒装形式之一。
points: Were + 主语 + 表语：Were I you, I would apologize.（= If I were you）
Had + 主语 + 过去分词：Had I known, I would have helped.（= If I had known）
Should + 主语 + 动词原形：Should it rain, we would stay in.（= If it should rain）
只有 were、had、should 能这样提前，其他动词不行。
省略 if 后不再有 if，主句和从句之间照常加逗号。

examples.en: Were I you, I would accept the offer.
examples.zh: 我要是你，就接受这个职位。
examples.note: were 提前，相当于 If I were you。

examples.en: Had he studied harder, he would have passed.
examples.zh: 他要是当时更用功，就通过了。
examples.note: had 提前，相当于 If he had studied harder。

examples.en: Should you need help, call me.
examples.zh: 万一你需要帮助，给我打电话。
examples.note: should 提前，主句可以是祈使句。

examples.en: Had it not been for your help, I would have failed.
examples.zh: 要不是你的帮助，我就失败了。
examples.note: 否定式：had it not been for，注意 not 的位置。

title: 让步倒装
summary: as 引导让步状语从句时必须倒装，把表语、状语或动词原形提到句首；though 也可以这样用，但更常见的是正常语序。
points: as 让步倒装：表语/副词/动词原形 + as + 主语 + 谓语（Young as he is, he knows a lot.）。
名词提前时不带冠词：Child as he is, he knows a lot.（不是 A child as he is）
though 也能这样倒装，语气更书面：Hard as he tried, he failed. = Though he tried hard, he failed.
动词原形提前时，从句谓语常用 may/might/would：Try as he might, he couldn't open it.
as 引导原因或时间状语时不倒装，只有让步用法才倒装。

examples.en: Young as he is, he knows a lot.
examples.zh: 尽管他年轻，他懂得很多。
examples.note: 表语 young 提前，as 引导让步。

examples.en: Child as he is, he can solve the problem.
examples.zh: 虽然他还是个孩子，却能解决这个问题。
examples.note: 名词提前时不带冠词，不能说 a child as he is。

examples.en: Hard as he tried, he failed.
examples.zh: 尽管他很努力，还是失败了。
examples.note: 副词 hard 提前，相当于 Though he tried hard。

examples.en: Try as he might, he couldn't open the door.
examples.zh: 无论他怎么使劲，也打不开门。
examples.note: 动词原形 try 提前，后面用 might。

title: so 与 such 开头
summary: 结果状语从句里，把 so + 形容词/副词 或 such + 名词提到句首时，主句要倒装，句式是「So + adj + be/助动词 + 主语 + that 从句」。
points: 结构：So + 形容词/副词 + 助动词/be + 主语 + that 从句。
名词形式：Such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + be + 主语 + that 从句。
so 修饰形容词或副词，such 修饰名词，两者不能互换。
倒装只发生在主句，that 从句用正常语序。
这类倒装多用于书面语，语气比正常语序强。

examples.en: So tired was he that he fell asleep at once.
examples.zh: 他太累了，马上就睡着了。
examples.note: so + 形容词提前，be 动词 was 提到主语前。

examples.en: So loudly did he speak that everyone turned around.
examples.zh: 他声音太大，大家都转过头来。
examples.note: so + 副词提前，借助动词 did。

examples.en: Such was his anger that he couldn't speak.
examples.note: such 作表语提前，be 动词提到主语前。

examples.en: Such a good boy is he that everyone likes him.
examples.zh: 他是个好孩子，大家都喜欢他。
examples.note: such + a + 形容词 + 名词提前，is 提到主语前。

title: 易错点与辨析
summary: 倒装的错集中在三处：该倒装的没倒、倒了却漏掉助动词、以及把倒装和强调句搞混。判断时先看句首是什么成分。
points: 否定词或 only + 状语放在句首时必须倒装；只把词放到句首却不倒装，是最常见的中式英语。
部分倒装必须借助助动词：Never I saw 要改成 Never did I see。
主语是代词时，here/there 开头也不倒装：Here you are.（不是 Here are you.）
not only 所在分句倒装，but also 分句不倒装；not until 只倒装主句。
倒装不等于强调句：It was...that... 是强调句，句子语序不变；倒装改变的是语序。

examples.en: Never did I see such a thing.
examples.note: 否定词开头必须倒装，借助动词 did，实义动词用原形。

examples.en: Here you are.
examples.note: 主语是代词 you，here 开头也不倒装。

examples.en: Not only is he a teacher, but he is also a writer.
examples.zh: 他不仅是老师，还是作家。
examples.note: 前半句倒装 is，后半句用正常语序。

examples.en: Young as he is, he is very capable.
examples.note: as 引导让步必须倒装，把表语 young 提到句首。

examples.en: It was in 2020 that he came here.
examples.zh: 他是 2020 年来到这里的。
examples.note: 这是强调句，不是倒装，不能把 came 提到 he 前面。

title: 强调句入门
summary: 强调句用 It is/was ... that ... 把句子里想突出的部分夹在中间，其余部分照原样放在 that 后面。判断方法：去掉 It is/was 和 that，剩下的能不能还原成一个完整句子。
points: 基本结构：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余部分。
能强调的成分：主语、宾语、状语（时间、地点、原因、方式等）；谓语动词不能这样强调。
强调主语且指人时，that 可以换成 who；强调宾语或状语时一般只用 that。
判断方法（还原法）：去掉 It is/was 和 that 后，剩下的词能拼成完整句子，就是强调句。
强调句不改变原句的意思，只改变信息重心。

examples.en: It is Tom that/who broke the window.
examples.note: 强调主语 Tom，指人时可以用 who。

examples.en: It was a new bike that he bought yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天买的是一辆新自行车。
examples.note: 强调宾语 a new bike。

examples.en: It was in the park that they met.
examples.zh: 他们是在公园里见面的。
examples.note: 强调地点状语 in the park。

examples.en: It was because he was ill that he didn't come.
examples.note: 强调原因状语从句，还原后是 He didn't come because he was ill.

title: 强调句的构成
summary: 强调句用 is 还是 was 取决于原句时态；被强调部分放在 It is/was 后面，that 后面保持原句的正常语序，不倒装。
points: 原句是现在时或将来时用 It is...；原句是过去时用 It was...。
强调主语时，that/who 后面直接接谓语，谓语的数与被强调的名词一致。
强调宾语或状语时，that 后面先出现原句的主语，再接谓语。
that 后面必须是陈述语序，不能因为强调就把助动词提到主语前面。
强调时间、地点、原因、方式状语一律用 that，不用 when、where、why。

examples.en: It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
examples.zh: 每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。
examples.note: 原句现在时用 is；强调主语，指人用 who。

examples.en: It was in 2015 that he joined the company.
examples.zh: 他是 2015 年加入公司的。
examples.note: 原句过去时用 was；强调时间状语用 that，不用 when。

examples.en: It was the book that she gave me.
examples.note: 强调宾语，that 后面是 she gave me 的正常语序。

examples.en: It is not money that makes people happy.
examples.note: 否定形式：not 放在 is/was 后面。

title: 时态与一致
summary: 强调句的 be 动词跟着原句时态走；被强调部分作主语时，that/who 后面的谓语要和它保持一致——这一点最容易和定语从句混淆。
points: 一般现在时、现在完成时、将来时用 It is；一般过去时、过去完成时用 It was。
强调主语时，从句谓语的数由被强调的名词决定：It is the students who are late.
强调宾语时，that 后面主语的数与谓语的一致关系保持不变。
原句有 always、often 等频度副词时，副词位置保持原样。
强调句不能同时强调两个成分，需要时用两个句子分别强调。

examples.en: It is the students who are working hard.
examples.note: 强调复数主语，从句谓语用 are。

examples.en: It was his parents that helped him out.
examples.zh: 是他父母帮他渡过难关的。
examples.note: 原句过去时，用 was。

examples.en: It is I who am to blame.
examples.note: 正式文体里强调主语 I，从句谓语用 am。

examples.en: It was yesterday that we finished the work.
examples.zh: 我们是昨天完成这项工作的。
examples.note: 强调时间状语，用 that。

title: 否定与疑问
summary: 强调句的否定形式是 It is not ... that ...；一般疑问句把 is/was 提前；特殊疑问句用「疑问词 + is/was it that ...」。
points: 否定：It is not + 被强调部分 + that ...；口语里也可以缩写 It isn't ...
一般疑问：Is/Was it + 被强调部分 + that ...? 答语用 Yes, it is/was.
特殊疑问：疑问词 + is/was it that ...?（Who was it that...? / When was it that...?）
特殊疑问句里 that 一般不改写；疑问词本身作主语时，用 who 更自然。
not until 的强调有固定格式，见下一节。

examples.en: It was not Tom that broke the window.
examples.note: 否定形式：not 放在 is/was 后面。

examples.en: Was it in 2010 that you met her?
examples.zh: 你是在 2010 年遇见她的吗？
examples.note: 一般疑问句把 was 提到句首。

examples.en: When was it that you moved here?
examples.note: 特殊疑问句用「疑问词 + was it that」。

examples.en: Who was it that called me?
examples.note: 疑问词作主语，用 who 更自然。

title: not until 强调
summary: 强调「直到……才」用 It was not until ... that ...，此时 not 与 until 一起提前，that 后面用肯定语序，不能再倒装。
points: 结构：It was not until + 时间/从句 + that + 主语 + 谓语（肯定形式）。
not 必须和 until 一起提前，不能写成 It was until ... not ...。
that 后面的部分用正常语序，不倒装——这是和 Not until ... did ... 倒装句的关键区别。
be 动词用 is 还是 was 由原句时态决定，过去的事用 was。
两种句式可以互换：It was not until he came that I left. = Not until he came did I leave.

examples.en: It was not until midnight that he came back.
examples.note: not until 一起提前，that 后用肯定语序 came back。

examples.en: It was not until he explained it that I understood.
examples.zh: 直到他解释了我才明白。
examples.note: until 后面接的是从句。

examples.en: It was not until 2019 that they met again.
examples.zh: 直到 2019 年他们才再次见面。
examples.note: 强调时间点，注意 not 与 until 不能拆开。

examples.en: Not until he came did I leave.
examples.note: 这是倒装句，与强调句可以互相改写。

title: what 强调
summary: 除了 It is...that...，还可以用 what 从句把要强调的内容提到句子前面：What I need is a rest. 这种结构强调的是「……的东西/事情」。
points: 结构：What + 主语 + 谓语 + is/was + 被强调的名词或动作。
强调动作时常用 do：What he did was (to) tell the truth. / All he did was ...
what 从句作主语，is 后面的名词是单数还是复数会影响谓语形式，两种说法都常见。
也可以用 The thing that ... / All that ... 替代 what。
和 It is...that... 的分工：what 强调「事物/内容」，It is...that 可以强调任何成分。

examples.en: What I need is a good rest.
examples.note: what 从句作主语，is 后面是强调的内容。

examples.en: What he did was (to) apologize.
examples.note: 强调动作，不定式前的 to 可以省略。

examples.en: All (that) she wants is a quiet life.
examples.zh: 她想要的只是安静的生活。
examples.note: All that 相当于 what，口语里 that 常省略。

examples.en: What surprised me was his attitude.
examples.zh: 让我吃惊的是他的态度。
examples.note: what 从句表示「让我吃惊的那件事」。

title: 与定语从句辨析
summary: 强调句、定语从句、主语从句都可能出现 It is ... that ...，区分方法是还原法：去掉 It is 和 that 后能还原成完整句子的是强调句。
points: 强调句：去掉 It is/was 和 that 后，剩下的词能拼成完整句子（It was in the park that they met. → They met in the park.）。
定语从句：去掉 It is 后剩下「先行词 + 从句」，从句不能独立成句（It is the park that we visited.）。
主语从句：It 是形式主语，that 从句本身结构完整（It is true that he lied. → That he lied is true.）。
再看 that 的作用：强调句的 that 不作成分，定语从句的 that 要作主语或宾语。
还原后时态、语序都能对上，是最可靠的检验。

examples.en: It was in the park that they met.
examples.note: 还原成 They met in the park.，是强调句。

examples.en: It is the park that we visited last year.
examples.zh: 这就是我们去年参观的那个公园。
examples.note: 去掉 It is 后剩 the park (that) we visited，是定语从句。

examples.en: It is true that he lied.
examples.note: it 是形式主语，that 从句才是真正的主语。

examples.en: It was because he was ill that he stayed at home.
examples.zh: 他待在家里是因为生病。
examples.note: 还原成 He stayed at home because he was ill.，强调原因状语。

title: 其它强调手段
summary: 强调不只有 It is...that。do/does/did 可以强调谓语动词，very/only 可以强调名词或状语，倒装、反问和感叹也能起强调作用。
points: do/does/did + 动词原形强调谓语：I do like it. / He did come.
only、very、just 等放在被强调的词前：He is the very person I want.
倒装表强调：Never have I seen such a thing.
反问句表强调：Isn't it beautiful? / Who doesn't know that?
感叹句和重复也能加强语气：What a pity! / It's very, very important.

examples.en: I do hope you can come.
examples.note: do 强调谓语动词 hope。

examples.en: He did finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 他确实按时完成了工作。
examples.note: did 强调过去时的谓语，后面用动词原形。

examples.en: She is the very person we are looking for.
examples.note: very 强调「正是、就是」。

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 我从没见过这么美的日落。
examples.note: 否定词开头的倒装起强调作用。

title: 易错点与辨析
summary: 强调句的错集中在四处：that 后面擅自改语序、该用 that 却用了 when/where、not until 位置放错、以及和定语从句混淆。
points: that 后面必须是原句的正常语序，不能倒装：It was he that did it（不是 did he）。
强调时间、地点、原因状语用 that，不用 when、where、why。
not until 的强调句里 not 必须与 until 一起提前，that 后用肯定语序。
强调主语时，that/who 后面谓语的数与被强调的名词一致。
拿不准就用还原法：去掉 It is/was 和 that，能还原成完整句子才是强调句。

examples.en: It was Tom that broke the window.
examples.note: that 后面用正常语序 broke the window，不能写成 did Tom break。

examples.en: It was in 2015 that he came to Beijing.
examples.zh: 他是 2015 年来到北京的。
examples.note: 强调时间用 that，不用 when。

examples.en: It was not until he left that I knew the truth.
examples.zh: 直到他走我才知道真相。
examples.note: not 与 until 一起提前，that 后是 I knew 的肯定语序。

examples.en: It is the students who are late.
examples.note: 强调复数主语，从句谓语用 are。

title: 省略与替代入门
summary: 英语不喜欢重复。把前面已经出现过的词删掉叫省略，用一个短词顶替它叫替代。两者都是为了简洁，但删掉的部分必须能从上下文补回来。
points: 省略是删掉重复的词：She can sing and (she can) dance.
替代是用 do、so、one、that 等词顶替重复内容：She can sing, and so can he.
省略后句子仍要语法完整、意思清楚；补不回来的成分不能省。
常见省略位置：并列句、状语从句、定语从句、不定式、口语问答。
常见替代词：do / do so、so / not、one / ones、that / those、the same。

examples.en: She can sing and dance.
examples.note: 并列谓语中重复的 she can 被省略。

examples.en: I asked him to stay, but he didn't want to.
examples.note: want to 后面省略了 stay，属于「保留 to」的省略。

examples.en: He likes coffee, and so do I.
examples.note: so do I 用 so 替代「喜欢咖啡」这件事。

examples.en: I'd like a red apple, not a green one.
examples.zh: 我想要个红苹果，不是绿的。
examples.note: one 替代前面的可数名词 apple。

title: 谓语省略
summary: 并列句里，后一分句与前面重复的谓语或助动词部分可以省略；也可以保留助动词、省掉实义动词，避免同一个动作说两遍。
points: 并列谓语重复的部分可以省：He opened the door and (he) walked in.
保留助动词、省略实义动词：She can play the piano, and her sister can too.
助动词不同时不能省：He has finished, but she hasn't.
省略的部分仍按前面的时态和语态理解。
疑问句的简短回答也属于省略：— Can he swim? — Yes, he can.

examples.en: He opened the door and walked in.
examples.note: 两个谓语共用一个主语 he，第二个 he 省略。

examples.en: She can play the piano, and her sister can too.
examples.zh: 她会弹钢琴，她妹妹也会。
examples.note: can 后面省略 play the piano。

examples.en: He has finished his work, but she hasn't.
examples.zh: 他完成了工作，她还没有。
examples.note: 两个分句助动词不同，各自保留。

examples.en: — Can he swim? — Yes, he can.
examples.note: 简短回答省略了 swim。

title: 主语宾语省略
summary: 并列句中后一分句与前一分句主语相同时可以省略主语；祈使句的主语 you 本来就不出现；口语里主语、宾语也常省略。
points: 并列句主语相同，可省第二个主语：She came in and (she) sat down.
主语不同则不能省：She came in and he sat down.
祈使句主语 you 一律省略：Open the door.
口语里可省主语：— Want some coffee?（省略 Do you want）
宾语省略多见于口语，正式回答常改用替代词：— Do you like it? — Yes, I do.

examples.en: She came in and sat down.
examples.note: 第二个分句的 she 省略。

examples.en: She came in and he sat down.
examples.note: 两个分句主语不同，任何一个都不能省。

examples.en: Open the door, please.
examples.note: 祈使句主语 you 不出现。

examples.en: — Want some coffee? — No, thanks.
examples.note: 口语省略了 Do you。

examples.en: — Do you like it? — Yes, I do.
examples.note: 用 do 替代 like it，属于替代而不是单纯省略。

title: 不定式与 to
summary: 前面已经出现过的动词，后面再用不定式时可以只保留 to、省掉动词；但如果 to 是介词，后面就必须跟名词或动名词，不能省。
points: 保留 to、省略动词：I asked him to stay, but he didn't want to.
常见搭配：want to、hope to、try to、would like to、be glad to、be afraid to。
并列不定式可省第二个 to：I want to sit down and (to) rest.
to 作介词时（look forward to、be used to）后面必须跟名词或动名词。
有些结构必须省略 to：make/let/have sb do、had better do、why not do。

examples.en: I asked him to stay, but he didn't want to.
examples.note: want 后省略 stay，只保留 to。

examples.en: — Would you like to come? — I'd love to.
examples.note: I'd love to 后面省略 come。

examples.en: I want to sit down and rest.
examples.note: 并列不定式省略第二个 to。

examples.en: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
examples.note: to 是介词，后面必须跟动名词 seeing。

examples.en: Let me help you.
examples.note: let sb do 中 to 必须省略。

title: 状语从句省略
summary: 时间、条件、让步从句里，如果从句主语与主句主语一致、谓语又含 be，可以省掉主语和 be，只留分词、形容词或介词短语。
points: 省略的前提：从句主语 = 主句主语，且从句谓语含有 be。
保留分词：When (he was) young, he lived in the country. / While (I was) walking, I met him.
保留形容词、介词短语：If (it is) necessary, call me. / Though (he was) in danger, he stayed calm.
主语不一致时不能省略，否则就成了悬垂分词。
before、after、until 等从句同样适用：After (he had) finished the work, he left.

examples.en: When young, he lived in the countryside.
examples.note: 省略 he was，只留形容词 young。

examples.en: While walking in the park, I met an old friend.
examples.zh: 在公园散步时，我遇到一位老朋友。
examples.note: 主动关系用现在分词 walking。

examples.en: If necessary, call me.
examples.zh: 如果有必要，给我打电话。
examples.note: 省略 it is，只留形容词 necessary。

examples.en: After finishing the work, he left.
examples.note: 主动关系用动名词 finishing，主语与主句一致。

examples.en: When he came in, I was reading.
examples.note: 主从句主语不同，不能省略成 When coming in。

title: 定语从句省略
summary: 关系代词在定语从句中作宾语时可以省略，作主语时不能省；关系副词和「介词 + 关系代词」结构一般也不能省。
points: 关系代词作宾语可省：The book (that/which) I bought is interesting.
关系代词作主语不能省：The man who called you is my uncle.
「介词 + 关系代词」结构里不能省：the pen with which he writes。
关系副词 when、where、why 一般不能省：the day when we met。
非限制性定语从句的关系词一律不能省：He passed the exam, which surprised us.

examples.en: The book I bought yesterday is interesting.
examples.zh: 我昨天买的那本书很有意思。
examples.note: 省略了作宾语的关系代词 that / which。

examples.en: The man who called you is my uncle.
examples.zh: 给你打电话的那个人是我叔叔。
examples.note: 关系代词作主语，不能省略。

examples.en: This is the pen with which he writes.
examples.zh: 这就是他写字用的那支笔。
examples.note: 介词 + which 结构不能省略。

examples.en: He passed the exam, which surprised us.
examples.zh: 他通过了考试，这让我们很惊讶。
examples.note: 非限制性定语从句的关系词不能省略。

title: do so 替代
en: do so / do it / do that
summary: do so 替代前面提到的「动词 + 宾语」这个动作，避免重复；do it、do that 更具体，指代某个已知的动作或事情。
points: do so 替代动词短语：He asked me to leave, and I did so.（= I left）
do so 多用于正式或书面语，口语里常用 do that / do it。
do it 中的 it 指具体事物：— Please open the window. — I'll do it.
do that 指「那样做」，常带对比或不满：Don't do that again.
so 也能替代整个从句内容：I think so. / I hope not.

examples.en: He asked me to leave, and I did so.
examples.zh: 他让我离开，我就离开了。
examples.note: did so 替代 left。

examples.en: — Please open the window. — I'll do it.
examples.note: it 指开窗这件事。

examples.en: Don't do that again.
examples.note: do that 指前面提到的行为。

examples.en: I think so.
examples.note: so 替代前文整个从句的内容。

title: so 与 not
summary: 在 think、hope、believe、suppose、be afraid 等词后，用 so 代替肯定的从句、用 not 代替否定的从句，避免把整句再说一遍。
points: 肯定用 so：I think so. / I hope so. / I'm afraid so.
否定用 not：I hope not. / I'm afraid not. / I suppose not.
只适用于少数动词和说法（think、believe、hope、suppose、expect、guess、be afraid），不能随便套。
so 也可放在句首表示「也确实如此」：— He is tired. — So he is.
I don't think so 与 I think not 都对，前者更常见。

examples.en: — Will it rain? — I hope not.
examples.note: not 替代 it won't rain。

examples.en: — Is he coming? — I think so.
examples.note: so 替代 he is coming。

examples.en: — Are you sure? — I'm afraid so.
examples.note: be afraid so 是固定说法。

examples.en: — He is tired. — So he is.
examples.note: so 提前表示「确实如此」，注意和倒装的 so do I 区分。

title: one 与 that
summary: one/ones 替代可数名词，that/those 替代前面出现的名词（多带后置修饰），the same 替代相同的事物。选择看名词可数不可数、有没有后置修饰。
points: one/ones 替代可数名词：a red apple → a green one；these books → the new ones。
that/those 替代名词，常带 of 短语或定语从句：The weather here is better than that in Beijing.
those 常用于 those who ... 结构：Those who work hard will succeed.
the same 表示「同样的事物」：— I'll have a coffee. — The same for me.
不可数名词不能用 one 替代，要用 that 或直接重复。

examples.en: I'd like a red apple, not a green one.
examples.zh: 我要红苹果，不要绿苹果。
examples.note: one 替代可数名词 apple。

examples.en: These shoes are too small; I need bigger ones.
examples.zh: 这双鞋太小了，我需要大一点的。
examples.note: ones 替代复数 shoes。

examples.en: The weather in Kunming is better than that in Beijing.
examples.note: that 替代不可数名词 weather。

examples.en: Those who work hard will succeed.
examples.note: those 替代 people，后面接定语从句。

examples.en: — I'll have a coffee. — The same for me.
examples.note: the same 替代同样的东西。

title: 易错点与辨析
summary: 省略的错集中在三处：省掉了补不回来的成分、该保留 to 的时候漏掉、以及主语不一致还硬省造成悬垂分词。替代的错主要是 one / that / those 选错。
points: 省略后必须能补回来：I like it more than he 有歧义，要写成 than he does。
不定式省略动词时要保留 to：I didn't want to（不是 I didn't want）。
状语从句省略要求主语一致，否则就是悬垂分词。
one 只替代可数名词；不可数名词用 that。
比较句里省略要避免歧义，必要时补上助动词。

examples.en: I like coffee more than he does.
examples.note: 省略谓语后要补 does，否则会误解成「比他这个人」。

examples.en: — Would you like to join us? — I'd love to.
examples.zh: ——你愿意加入我们吗？——我很愿意。
examples.note: 省略 join us，但 to 必须保留。

examples.en: While waiting for the bus, I read a book.
examples.note: 主语一致，省略 I was 是正确的。

examples.en: Looking out of the window, I found the garden beautiful.
examples.zh: 从窗户望出去，我发现花园很美。
examples.note: 原句写成 the garden was beautiful 就主语不一致，成了悬垂分词。

examples.en: The water here is cleaner than that in the river.
examples.zh: 这里的水比河里的干净。
examples.note: water 不可数，用 that 替代，不能用 one。

title: 引语入门
summary: 直接引语是原话加引号；间接引语是把原话转述进自己的句子，不加引号。转述时要同时处理三件事：人称、时态、时间地点状语。
points: 直接引语照抄原话并加引号：He said, "I am busy."
间接引语用从句转述，不加引号：He said (that) he was busy.
转述三要素：人称跟着转述者变、时态往后移一步、时间地点状语换说法。
引导词按句型选：陈述句用 that（可省）、一般疑问句用 if/whether、特殊疑问句保留疑问词、祈使句用 to do。
转述动词：say、tell、ask、order、advise 等；tell 后面必须跟人。

examples.en: He said, "I am busy." → He said (that) he was busy.
examples.note: 去掉引号，时态后移，人称改成 he。

examples.en: She said to me, "I'll call you." → She told me she would call me.
examples.zh: 她对我说她会给我打电话。
examples.note: say to sb 转述时通常改成 tell sb。

examples.en: He asked, "Are you ready?" → He asked if I was ready.
examples.note: 一般疑问句用 if 引导，语序变陈述。

examples.en: "Open the door," he said. → He told me to open the door.
examples.note: 祈使句转述用 tell sb to do。

title: 时态后移
summary: 主句是过去时（said、told、asked）时，间接引语里的时态一般要往后移一步：现在变过去，过去变过去完成，将来变过去将来。
points: 一般现在时 → 一般过去时：am/is/are → was/were，do → did。
现在进行时 → 过去进行时；现在完成时 → 过去完成时。
一般过去时 → 过去完成时；过去完成时保持不变。
will → would；can → could；may → might；表「必须」的 must → had to。
主句是现在时（says、tells）时，从句时态不必后移。

examples.en: "I work here," he said. → He said he worked there.
examples.note: work → worked，here → there。

examples.en: "I am reading," she said. → She said she was reading.
examples.note: 现在进行时 → 过去进行时。

examples.en: "I have finished," he said. → He said he had finished.
examples.note: 现在完成时 → 过去完成时。

examples.en: "I will help you," she said. → She said she would help me.
examples.note: will → would，you → me。

examples.en: He says he is busy.
examples.note: 主句是现在时 says，从句时态不变。

title: 人称与指示词
summary: 转述时人称按「谁在说、说给谁」调整：第一人称跟着说话人变，第二人称跟着听话人变，第三人称一般不变。指示词 this/these 通常变成 that/those。
points: 第一人称 I/we/my/our → 说话人：He said, "I lost my key." → He said he had lost his key.
第二人称 you/your → 听话人：She said to me, "You are right." → She told me I was right.
第三人称一般不变，但所有格要跟着变：Tom said, "She is my sister." → Tom said she was his sister.
this → that，these → those；指代很清楚时也可以不变。
my → his/her、your → my 这类所有格变化最容易漏。

examples.en: He said, "I lost my key." → He said he had lost his key.
examples.note: I → he，my → his，lost → had lost。

examples.en: She said to me, "You are right." → She told me I was right.
examples.note: you → I，因为听话人是「我」。

examples.en: Tom said, "She is my sister." → Tom said she was his sister.
examples.note: 第三人称 she 不变，my → his。

examples.en: He said, "This is my book." → He said that was his book.
examples.note: this → that，my → his。

title: 时间地点变化
summary: 转述发生在事后，原来的时间地点词往往要换：now→then、today→that day、tomorrow→the next day、here→there。若转述就在原地当天说，也可以不改。
points: 时间：now → then；today → that day；tonight → that night。
时间：yesterday → the day before；tomorrow → the next day；last week → the week before；next week → the following week。
ago → before；this morning → that morning。
地点与指示：here → there；this → that；these → those。
转述地点没变、时间就是当天时，here / today 等可以保持不变。

examples.en: "I'll see you tomorrow," he said. → He said he would see me the next day.
examples.note: tomorrow → the next day，will → would。

examples.en: "I saw her yesterday," she said. → She said she had seen her the day before.
examples.note: yesterday → the day before，saw → had seen。

examples.en: "Come here," he said. → He told me to go there.
examples.note: here → there，come → go。

examples.en: "We are busy today," they said. → They said they were busy that day.
examples.note: today → that day，are → were。

examples.en: He said, "I'm coming now." → He said he was coming then.
examples.note: now → then，现在进行 → 过去进行。

title: 陈述句转述
summary: 陈述句转述用 say/tell + that 从句，从句一律用陈述语序；say 后面不直接接人，tell 后面必须接人。
points: 句型：say (that) + 从句；tell sb (that) + 从句。
tell 后面必须跟人，不能直接说 tell that ...。
that 在口语里常省略，书面语可以保留。
从句用陈述语序，不能保留原来的疑问语序。
转述动词可按语义换成 believe、think、admit、explain、complain 等。

examples.en: He said, "I am tired." → He said (that) he was tired.
examples.note: say + that 从句，that 可省略。

examples.en: He said to me, "I am tired." → He told me (that) he was tired.
examples.note: say to sb 转述时改写成 tell sb。

examples.en: She said, "I don't know him." → She said she didn't know him.
examples.note: 否定句直接放进 that 从句，时态后移。

examples.en: He admitted, "I made a mistake." → He admitted that he had made a mistake.
examples.note: 转述动词可换成 admit，时态照样后移。

title: 疑问句转述
summary: 疑问句转述用 ask 引导：一般疑问句用 if/whether，特殊疑问句保留原疑问词。两种情况都要改成陈述语序，句末用句号。
points: 一般疑问句：ask (sb) if/whether + 陈述语序从句。
特殊疑问句：ask (sb) + 疑问词 + 陈述语序从句。
转述后不再倒装：不能写成 he asked where did I live。
疑问句里的 do/does/did 在转述时去掉。
选择疑问句用 whether ... or ...，不用 if。

examples.en: "Do you like it?" he asked. → He asked if I liked it.
examples.note: 一般疑问句用 if，助动词 do 去掉。

examples.en: "Where do you live?" she asked. → She asked where I lived.
examples.note: 保留 where，改成陈述语序 lived。

examples.en: "Did you see him?" he asked. → He asked whether I had seen him.
examples.note: whether 也可以，did 去掉，时态后移到 had seen。

examples.en: "Are you coming or not?" she asked. → She asked whether I was coming or not.
examples.note: 选择疑问句用 whether ... or not。

examples.en: "Why are you late?" he asked. → He asked why I was late.
examples.note: are you late 改成陈述语序 I was late。

title: 祈使句转述
summary: 祈使句转述用 tell/ask/order/advise + sb + to do；否定祈使用 not to do；let's 转述用 suggest doing 或 suggest that ...。
points: 肯定祈使：tell/ask sb to do。
否定祈使：tell/ask sb not to do（不是 to not do）。
按语气选动词：order（命令）、ask（请求）、advise（建议）、warn（警告）、remind（提醒）。
let's 转述：suggest doing，或 suggest that we (should) do。
祈使句转述不用 that 从句，注意别写成 He told me that sit down。

examples.en: "Sit down," he said. → He told me to sit down.
examples.note: 肯定祈使用 tell sb to do。

examples.en: "Don't be late," she said. → She told me not to be late.
examples.note: 否定祈使用 not to do。

examples.en: "Please help me," he said. → He asked me to help him.
examples.note: 请求用 ask，不用 tell。

examples.en: "Let's go swimming," he said. → He suggested going swimming.
examples.note: let's 转述用 suggest doing。

examples.en: "Remember to lock the door," she said. → She reminded me to lock the door.
examples.note: 按语义换成 remind sb to do。

title: 特殊句式转述
summary: 感叹句、祝愿、提议、请求许可没有统一公式，关键是选对转述动词：感叹用 say/exclaim，提议用 offer，祝愿用 wish。
points: 感叹句转述常用 say 或 exclaim：She said, "What a clever boy you are!" → She said what a clever boy I was.
祝愿：He said, "Good luck!" → He wished me good luck.
提议：He said, "Shall I carry it?" → He offered to carry it.
请求许可：She said, "May I use your phone?" → She asked if she might use my phone.
转述保留原意、按句意重写句式，不要逐字硬翻。

examples.en: "What a clever boy you are!" she said. → She said what a clever boy I was.
examples.note: 感叹句保留感叹形式，时态和人称照常变。

examples.en: "Good luck!" he said. → He wished me good luck.
examples.note: 祝愿用 wish sb sth。

examples.en: "Shall I help you?" he said. → He offered to help me.
examples.note: 主动提议用 offer to do。

examples.en: "May I use your phone?" she said. → She asked if she might use my phone.
examples.zh: 她问她能否用我的手机。
examples.note: may → might，疑问用 if，your → my。

title: 不变时态的情况
summary: 时态后移不是绝对的：客观真理、引语内容现在仍成立、主句是现在时、以及虚拟语气，都可以保持不变。
points: 客观真理、自然规律不变：He said the earth moves around the sun.
引语内容现在仍然成立时也可以不变：She said she is only 20.
主句是现在时、现在完成时或将来时时不变：He says he will come.
虚拟语气不后移：He said, "If I were you, I would go." → He said if he were me, he would go.
过去完成时本身就是「过去的过去」，不再往后移。

examples.en: He said the earth moves around the sun.
examples.note: 客观真理保持一般现在时。

examples.en: She said she is only 20.
examples.note: 转述时她仍然是 20 岁，可以不变时态。

examples.en: He says he will come tomorrow.
examples.note: 主句是现在时，从句不必后移。

examples.en: He said if he were me, he would go.
examples.note: 虚拟语气保持原形，不再后移。

title: 易错点与辨析
summary: 转述的错集中在四处：只改时态忘了人称、疑问句仍用倒装、tell 后面漏人、以及把本来不用改的状语也改了。
points: 三要素要一起改：时态、人称、时间地点状语，只改一样就会出问题。
疑问句转述后必须是陈述语序：He asked where did I live（错）→ He asked where I lived.
tell 后面必须跟人：He told that ...（错）→ He said that ... 或 He told me that ...
here、today 在原地说时可以不改，不要机械替换。
祈使句转述用 to do，不要写成 that 从句。

examples.en: "I am leaving for London tomorrow," he said. → He said he was leaving for London the next day.
examples.zh: 他说他第二天要去伦敦。
examples.note: 时态、人称、时间状语三处都改了。

examples.en: He asked me where I lived.
examples.note: 疑问句转述必须用陈述语序，不能倒装成 where did I live。

examples.en: He told me that he was busy.
examples.note: tell 后面要跟人，不能只说 tell that。

examples.en: She told me not to be late.
examples.note: 否定祈使用 not to do，既不是 to not do，也不是 that 从句。

title: 疑问与否定入门
summary: 疑问句和否定句都要借助助动词：疑问句把助动词提到主语前，否定句在助动词后面加 not。句子里没有助动词时，用 do/does/did 补出来。
points: 四种疑问句：一般疑问句（Yes/No）、特殊疑问句（疑问词开头）、选择疑问句（or）、反义疑问句（附加问句）。
疑问句的基本操作：把 be 动词、助动词或情态动词提到主语前面。
没有助动词时用 do/does/did 帮忙：Do you like it? / Did he come?
否定句的基本操作：在第一个助动词后面加 not；没有助动词就用 do/does/did + not。
一旦用了 do/does/did，后面的实义动词一律用原形。

examples.en: Are you a student?
examples.note: be 动词直接提到主语前。

examples.en: Do you like music?
examples.note: 句子里没有助动词，用 do 帮忙。

examples.en: He didn't come yesterday.
examples.note: 过去时用 didn't，后面接原形 come。

examples.en: Where do you live?
examples.note: 疑问词 + do + 主语 + 原形。

title: 一般疑问句
summary: 一般疑问句把 be、助动词或情态动词提到主语前，回答用 Yes/No；这些词都没有时用 do/does/did。
points: be 动词提前：Is he your brother? / Were they at home?
助动词或情态动词提前：Have you finished? / Can she swim?
实义动词用 do/does/did：Do they know? / Did you see him?
简短回答的助动词要与问句一致：— Do you like it? — Yes, I do.
否定回答用 No + 否定形式：No, I don't. / No, he isn't.

examples.en: Is she at home? — Yes, she is.
examples.note: be 动词提前，回答也用 is。

examples.en: Have you finished your work?
examples.note: 完成时把 have 提到主语前。

examples.en: Do they live here? — No, they don't.
examples.note: 实义动词用 do，回答保持一致。

examples.en: Did he call you? — Yes, he did.
examples.zh: 他给你打电话了吗？——打了。
examples.note: 过去时用 did，回答也用 did。

title: 特殊疑问句
summary: 特殊疑问句以疑问词开头，结构是「疑问词 + 助动词 + 主语 + 实义动词」；但疑问词本身作主语时，语序和陈述句一样，不倒装。
points: 常见疑问词：what、who、whom、whose、which、when、where、why、how。
结构：疑问词 + 助动词/be + 主语 + 主要动词（Where did you go?）。
疑问词作主语时不倒装，也不加 do：Who broke the window? / What happened?
how 可与形容词、副词搭配：how long、how often、how far、how much。
疑问词可以带介词：With whom did you go?（口语常把介词放句末）

examples.en: Where did you go last night?
examples.note: 疑问词 + did + 主语 + 原形。

examples.en: Who broke the window?
examples.note: who 作主语，语序与陈述句相同，不加 did。

examples.en: What happened to him?
examples.note: what 作主语，直接用 happened。

examples.en: How often do you exercise?
examples.note: how often 问频率。

examples.en: Whose book is this?
examples.note: whose 作定语，is 提到主语前。

title: 反义疑问句
summary: 反义疑问句由「陈述句 + 简短问句」构成：前肯后否、前否后肯，问句部分的助动词、时态和人称都要与前句一致。
points: 前肯后否：You are a teacher, aren't you?
前否后肯：He doesn't like it, does he?
前句含 never、hardly、few、little、nothing 等否定词时，按否定处理，问句用肯定形式。
特殊主语：I am ... → aren't I；Let's ... → shall we；祈使句 → will you。
回答看事实，不看问句形式：— You didn't come, did you? — Yes, I did.（来了）

examples.en: You are a teacher, aren't you?
examples.note: 前肯后否，助动词与主语都与前句一致。

examples.en: He doesn't like coffee, does he?
examples.note: 前否后肯，用 does。

examples.en: Let's go, shall we?
examples.note: Let's 开头用 shall we。

examples.en: Open the window, will you?
examples.note: 祈使句用 will you。

examples.en: — You didn't come yesterday, did you? — Yes, I did.
examples.note: 回答看事实：Yes 表示「来了」。

title: 选择与否定疑问
summary: 选择疑问句用 or 提供两个选项，回答不能再用 Yes/No；否定疑问句（Isn't it...?）常表示期待对方同意或惊讶。
points: 选择疑问句：一般疑问句 + or + 另一个选项（Do you want tea or coffee?）。
回答选择疑问句要直接选一个，不能用 Yes/No。
也有特殊疑问句形式的选择：Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
否定疑问句：Isn't she beautiful? / Don't you know him? 常含「我以为你……」的语气。
回答否定疑问句时 Yes 表示肯定事实：— Isn't he your brother? — Yes, he is.

examples.en: Do you want tea or coffee? — Coffee, please.
examples.note: 选择疑问句不能答 Yes/No。

examples.en: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢哪个，茶还是咖啡？
examples.note: 特殊疑问句形式的选择疑问句。

examples.en: Isn't she beautiful?
examples.note: 否定疑问句常表示赞叹或期待同意。

examples.en: — Don't you know him? — Yes, I do.
examples.note: Yes 表示肯定事实，与问句形式无关。

title: 否定句构成
summary: 否定句在第一个助动词后加 not；没有助动词时用 do/does/did + not，be 动词直接加 not。
points: be 动词 + not：He is not a doctor.
助动词或情态动词 + not：She has not finished. / You must not go.
实义动词用 do/does/did + not，后接原形：He doesn't know. / They didn't come.
否定词固定在第一个助动词之后：has not been、will not have。
常见缩写：isn't、aren't、don't、doesn't、didn't、won't、can't。

examples.en: He is not a doctor.
examples.note: be 动词后直接加 not。

examples.en: She hasn't finished her work.
examples.note: 完成时在 has 后面加 not。

examples.en: They didn't come to the party.
examples.note: 过去时用 didn't，后面用原形 come。

examples.en: You must not smoke here.
examples.note: 情态动词后直接加 not。

title: 否定词
summary: no、none、never、hardly、few、little 本身含否定意义，用了它们就不再另加 not；两个否定词同时出现通常表示肯定。
points: no = not any，直接修饰名词：There is no water. = There isn't any water.
none 指三者以上「一个也没有」，常与 of 连用：None of them came.
never 表示「从不」，本身是否定，不再加 not。
hardly、scarcely、seldom、rarely、few、little 是半否定词，按否定理解，反义疑问句用肯定形式。
双重否定表示肯定：He never fails to help.（他总是帮忙）

examples.en: There is no water in the bottle.
examples.note: no = not any，直接修饰名词。

examples.en: None of them came to the meeting.
examples.note: none 指三者以上「一个也没有」。

examples.en: He never tells lies.
examples.note: never 本身是否定，不再加 not。

examples.en: He hardly knows her, does he?
examples.note: hardly 是半否定，附加问句用肯定形式。

examples.en: He never fails to help others.
examples.note: 双重否定表示肯定。

title: 否定转移与部分否定
summary: think、believe、suppose 后的否定习惯提到主句；not all、not both、not every 表示部分否定，意思是「并非都」。
points: 否定转移：I don't think he is right.（= I think he isn't right.）
适用动词：think、believe、suppose、expect、imagine、feel。
not all / not every / not both 是部分否定：Not all students passed.（不是所有都及格）
全部否定用 none、neither、no one、nothing：None of the students passed.
not ... and ... 与 not ... or ... 含义不同，注意语境。

examples.en: I don't think he will come.
examples.note: 否定转移到主句，比 I think he won't come 更自然。

examples.en: Not all the students passed the exam.
examples.zh: 并不是所有学生都通过了考试。
examples.note: 部分否定，不能理解成「全都没过」。

examples.en: None of the students passed the exam.
examples.zh: 所有学生都没通过考试。
examples.note: 全部否定用 none。

examples.en: Not both of them came.
examples.zh: 他们俩没都来（只来了一个）。
examples.note: not both 是部分否定。

examples.en: Neither of them came.
examples.note: 全部否定用 neither。

title: 特殊否定结构
summary: 有些否定结构不能按字面理解：too...to、not...until、no sooner...than、cannot...too 都是固定含义。
points: too ... to do 表示「太……以至于不能」：He is too tired to walk.
not ... until 表示「直到……才」：He didn't leave until midnight.
no sooner ... than / hardly ... when 表示「一……就」，前半句用过去完成时。
cannot ... too 表示「再……也不过分」：You cannot be too careful.
not a little = very much；not a few = many，这两个要单独记。

examples.en: He is too tired to walk.
examples.note: too...to 表示否定的结果。

examples.en: He didn't leave until midnight.
examples.note: not...until 表示「直到……才」。

examples.en: No sooner had he sat down than the phone rang.
examples.note: no sooner...than，前半句用过去完成时并倒装。

examples.en: You cannot be too careful.
examples.note: cannot...too 表示「越……越好」。

examples.en: Not a few students failed.
examples.note: not a few = many，不是「没几个」。

title: 易错点与辨析
summary: 疑问句和否定句的错集中在助动词上：该用 do 时漏掉、用了 do 又没还原动词、反义疑问句的助动词与前句不一致。
points: 实义动词的疑问句和否定句必须用 do/does/did：Do you like it?（不是 You like it?）
用了 do/does/did 后，实义动词用原形：Did he went（错）→ Did he go.
疑问词作主语时不加 do：Who did break the window（错）→ Who broke the window.
反义疑问句的助动词、时态、人称要与前句一致；前句含 hardly/never 时用肯定问句。
否定转移只用于少数动词，别把 I think he isn't right 当成唯一正确说法。

examples.en: Do you like music?
examples.note: 实义动词的疑问句要加 do。

examples.en: Did he go to the party?
examples.note: did 后面用原形 go，不能用 went。

examples.en: Who broke the window?
examples.note: 疑问词作主语，不用 did。

examples.en: He hardly knows her, does he?
examples.note: 前句含 hardly，视为否定，问句用肯定形式。

examples.en: I don't think he is right.
examples.note: 否定转移到主句，是英语的惯用说法。
